resources.string: Optional, off by default. Show elapsed time and controls on supported system surfaces. Availability and appearance depend on Android and your device.
Requires a supporting Android 16 build or the HyperOS 3 island protocol. The ordinary notification, widget and tile remain available on Android 12+.

Experimental HyperOS client. Xiaomi approval for OTM has not been obtained, so the island may not appear. Only time, daily totals and controls are supplied, never project names or notes. Removing supplied data on lock or screen-off needs a running OTM process; immediate removal is not guaranteed. HyperOS rendering is unverified.
This Android build may keep the ordinary notification: the newer promotion API is unavailable.
Android allows promotion requests. Notification permission, channel settings and system or manufacturer criteria still apply; a chip is not guaranteed.
Android currently blocks promoted notifications for this app. The ordinary timer controls remain available when notifications are allowed.
Android promotion eligibility could not be read. This is not a guarantee of Live Update availability.
The current notification has promotable characteristics. This does not prove that Android will promote it.
The current notification does not meet Android’s promotion characteristics. It stays an ordinary notification.
Local choice, excluded from backups. Dismissing a notification suppresses requests for that entry, including after pause and resume. A new entry or turning this option off and on resets suppression.
Choice saved. Android controls the final presentation.
The choice could not be saved. Try again; the normal timer is unchanged.
Choice saved, but the notification could not be refreshed. Reopen the app or try again. Do not stop or recreate the timer just to refresh its appearance.
Android Live Update and app settings could not be opened on this device.
